keepsakes: A round table, cracked down the middle
A green ribbon from a tournament
An apple from an orchard island
chapters: He won every battle but the one that mattered.
The two people he loved most loved each other. He knew. He always knew.
The sword was lent, never given. The water wants it back.

endings.title: The Sword Returned
endings.text: He gives the blade back to the water and drinks the cup gladly, a man at last rather than a king.
endings.trigger: Key in Book, 0–7 forgotten

endings.title: The Sleeping King
endings.text: He refuses the cup. "If they need me, I will wake." He sleeps on the far shore, waiting.
endings.trigger: Key in Book, 8 or more forgotten

endings.title: The Friend at the Landing
endings.text: His old friend is waiting on the shore, and the king offers his hand before the friend can kneel.
endings.trigger: Key unspoken

endings.title: The Barge Drifts
endings.text: The barge never quite arrives. On foggy nights, ferrymen still see its banner.
endings.trigger: Key forgotten

endings.title: The Island of Apples
endings.text: The three veiled women steer the barge past the Far Shore, to an island of apple trees where he heals. The king who did not die.
endings.trigger: Key in Book and the apple Keepsake found and 0–3 forgotten (replaces A)

keepsakes: 一張從正中裂開的圓桌
一條比武大會上的綠色緞帶
一顆來自果園之島的蘋果
chapters: 他贏下了每一場戰役，唯獨那一場真正要緊的，他輸了。
他最愛的兩個人，彼此相愛。他知道。他一直都知道。
那柄劍是借來的，從來不是贈予。湖水要把它討回去了。

endings.title: 劍歸於湖
endings.text: 他將劍交還給湖水，欣然飲下那一杯。終於，他不再是國王，只是一個人。
endings.trigger: 關鍵記憶已銘刻於書中，遺忘0–7段

endings.title: 沉睡之王
endings.text: 他拒絕了那一杯。「若他們需要我，我便會醒來。」他在彼岸沉睡，靜靜等待。
endings.trigger: 關鍵記憶已銘刻於書中，遺忘8段以上

endings.title: 渡口的故友
endings.text: 他的老友正在岸邊等候；不待老友屈膝，國王已先伸出了手。
endings.trigger: 關鍵記憶未曾說出

endings.title: 渡船漂流
endings.text: 那艘渡船始終未能真正靠岸。每逢霧夜，擺渡人仍會望見它的旌旗。
endings.trigger: 關鍵記憶已遺忘

endings.title: 蘋果之島
endings.text: 三位蒙紗的女子駕著渡船越過彼岸，駛向一座長滿蘋果樹的小島，他在那裡得到療癒。那是一位不曾死去的國王。
endings.trigger: 關鍵記憶已銘刻於書中，且找到蘋果信物，且遺忘0–3段（取代結局A）

chapters: She had a flower for everyone. Everyone took one.
He said he had never loved her. Her father did not come home.
She gave the flowers away one by one, and sang, and the water was kind.

endings.title: A Flower for Everyone
endings.text: At the shore she hands the Keeper a flower, too, and drinks smiling.
endings.trigger: Key in Book, 0–7 forgotten

endings.title: Her Own Flower
endings.text: She keeps her last flower, and keeps herself. She refuses the cup and plants the flower on the far shore. It grows into the first Netherbloom.
endings.trigger: Key in Book, 8 or more forgotten

endings.title: The Unsung Verse
endings.text: She crosses humming a song that stops one line from the end.
endings.trigger: Key unspoken

endings.title: The Brook Keeps Her
endings.text: She turns back into the stream and becomes the water that sings under willows.
endings.trigger: Key forgotten

endings.title: The Garland Complete
endings.text: She weaves one last garland and gives it to the Ferrymen, who never said a word. "Thank you for listening."
endings.trigger: All three Book pages full (replaces whichever ending applies)

keepsakes: 寫了一半的最後一段歌詞
chapters: 她為每個人都備了一朵花。每個人都收下了。
他說他從未愛過她。她的父親再也沒有回家。
她將花一朵一朵送了出去，一邊唱著歌；而溪水待她很溫柔。

endings.title: 人人都有一朵花
endings.text: 來到岸邊，她也遞給守岸人一朵花，然後含笑飲下那一杯。
endings.trigger: 關鍵記憶已銘刻於書中，遺忘0–7段

endings.title: 她自己的花
endings.text: 她留下了最後一朵花，也留住了自己。她拒絕了那一杯，將那朵花種在彼岸。它長成了世上第一朵彼岸花。
endings.trigger: 關鍵記憶已銘刻於書中，遺忘8段以上

endings.title: 未唱完的一句
endings.text: 她哼著一首歌渡河而去，那首歌在最後一句之前戛然而止。
endings.trigger: 關鍵記憶未曾說出

endings.title: 溪水留住了她
endings.text: 她轉身回到溪流之中，化作在垂柳下低吟的流水。
endings.trigger: 關鍵記憶已遺忘

endings.title: 花環圓滿
endings.text: 她編好最後一個花環，送給那些始終一語不發的擺渡人。「謝謝你們聽我說。」
endings.trigger: 憶念之書三頁全部填滿（取代原本適用的結局）

keepsakes: A wedding crown of meadow flowers
A smooth stone from the meadow
A lamp that would not stay lit
Her veil, torn on a stone
chapters: She danced barefoot in the grass, and did not see the stone.
He came for her. No one had ever come for anyone.
One step. He was one step from the light, and he turned.

endings.title: She Forgives the Glance
endings.text: "He only wanted to see me." She drinks, and the anger goes first.
endings.trigger: Key in Book, 0–7 forgotten

endings.title: She Waits for Him
endings.text: She will not drink until he crosses too, and this time she will walk ahead.
endings.trigger: Key in Book, 8 or more forgotten

endings.title: The Unturned Face
endings.text: She never decides. She crosses with her eyes closed.
endings.trigger: Key unspoken

endings.title: A Stranger's Wedding
endings.text: She forgets him, and remembers only that there was music once.
endings.trigger: Key forgotten

endings.title: She Looks Back
endings.text: At the shore she turns to look back, and this time he is there, following her.
endings.trigger: The soul never Lingered all game, and Key in Book (replaces A or B)

keepsakes: 一頂草原野花編成的新娘花冠
一顆草原上的光滑石子
一盞怎麼也點不亮的燈
chapters: 她赤著腳在草地上起舞，沒有看見那塊石頭。
他為她而來。從來沒有人，曾為誰而來。
一步。離光明只差一步，他回頭了。

endings.title: 她原諒了那一眼
endings.text: 「他只是想看看我。」她飲下那一杯，最先消散的是她的怒氣。
endings.trigger: 關鍵記憶已銘刻於書中，遺忘0–7段

endings.title: 她等著他
endings.text: 在他也渡過河之前，她不肯飲下那一杯；而這一次，將由她走在前頭。
endings.trigger: 關鍵記憶已銘刻於書中，遺忘8段以上

endings.title: 未曾回首的臉
endings.text: 她始終沒有做出決定，就這樣閉著雙眼渡過了河。
endings.trigger: 關鍵記憶未曾說出

endings.title: 陌生人的婚禮
endings.text: 她忘了他，只記得曾經有過音樂。
endings.trigger: 關鍵記憶已遺忘

endings.title: 她回眸
endings.text: 來到岸邊時，換她轉身回望；而這一次，他就在那裡，一路跟隨著她。
endings.trigger: 亡魂整局遊戲從未徘徊，且關鍵記憶已銘刻於書中（取代結局A或B）

keepsakes: A shawl that smells of someone
chapters: No one bought a single light all day.
Each little flame showed her a different warm room.
With the last flame, someone came who did not leave.

endings.title: Carried Home
endings.text: She is lifted up in familiar arms and drinks the cup like warm milk.
endings.trigger: Key in Book, 0–7 forgotten

endings.title: The Last Flame Kept
endings.text: She stays on the river, lighting the way for lost children. One day she will carry a lantern like yours.
endings.trigger: Key in Book, 8 or more forgotten

endings.title: Warm at Last
endings.text: She does not know who carried her, only that she was warm.
endings.trigger: Key unspoken (any), or Key forgotten with 0–7 forgotten

endings.title: Morning
endings.text: In the morning, people found her smiling, and never knew why.
endings.trigger: Key forgotten, 8 or more forgotten

keepsakes: 一捆賣不出去的小火光
一枚她從未掙得的銅板
一條帶著某人氣味的披肩
chapters: 一整天，沒有人買下任何一點火光。
每一朵小小的火焰，都讓她看見一個不同的溫暖房間。
點亮最後一朵火焰時，有個人來了，而且沒有離開。

endings.title: 被抱回家
endings.text: 她被一雙熟悉的手臂抱起，像喝下一杯溫熱的牛奶般，飲下了那一杯。
endings.trigger: 關鍵記憶已銘刻於書中，遺忘0–7段

endings.title: 留住最後的火光
endings.text: 她留在河上，為迷途的孩子照亮道路。總有一天，她也會提著一盞像你們手中那樣的燈籠。
endings.trigger: 關鍵記憶已銘刻於書中，遺忘8段以上

endings.title: 終於溫暖
endings.text: 她不知道是誰抱起了她，只知道自己很溫暖。
endings.trigger: 關鍵記憶未曾說出（遺忘段數不限），或關鍵記憶已遺忘且遺忘0–7段

endings.title: 清晨
endings.text: 清晨時分，人們發現她帶著微笑，卻永遠不明白為什麼。
endings.trigger: 關鍵記憶已遺忘，遺忘8段以上

band.en: the market at the edge of the salt road
band.zh: 鹽路盡頭的那座市集

band.en: a master who beat me and taught me everything
band.zh: 打過我、也教會我一切的師父

band.en: swore an oath I was too young to understand
band.zh: 立下一個我當時年紀太小、還不懂的誓言

band.en: a hunger no bowl could fill
band.zh: 再多碗飯也填不滿的飢餓

band.en: the walls of a city that never let me in
band.zh: 一座從不讓我進去的城市的城牆

band.en: worked until the lamp oil ran dry
band.zh: 工作到燈油燃盡

band.en: a neighbour who mended my sandals for nothing
band.zh: 分文不取替我修補涼鞋的鄰居

band.en: a courtyard full of drying herbs
band.zh: 曬滿草藥的庭院

band.en: the hush after the last song of the night
band.zh: 夜裡最後一首歌唱完後的靜默

band.en: shared my last loaf of bread
band.zh: 把我最後一塊麵包分了出去

band.en: the one who waited at the ferry every evening
band.zh: 每天傍晚都在渡口等候的那個人

band.en: a lightness I had no name for
band.zh: 一種我叫不出名字的輕盈

band.en: my husband, who never came back across the river
band.zh: 再也沒有從河的那一頭回來的丈夫

band.en: gave the wrong medicine to the magistrate's son
band.zh: 給地方官的兒子用錯了藥

band.en: the kiln I ran from on a winter night
band.zh: 我在一個冬夜逃離的那座窯

band.en: the last lantern I made, which I never lit
band.zh: 我做的最後一盞、始終沒有點亮的燈籠

band.en: the watchtower where I left my brother
band.zh: 我丟下兄弟的那座瞭望塔

band.en: sang the final act while the playhouse burned
band.zh: 在戲院燃燒時唱完最後一幕

band.en: a fortune I counted every night and never spent
band.zh: 一筆我每晚清點、卻從未花用的財富

band.en: the abbot I could never please
band.zh: 我始終無法討好的修道院長

epilogue.en: She finally took the boat herself.
epilogue.zh: 她終於自己搭上了那艘船。

epilogue.en: Somewhere, a boy grew up healthy, and never knew.
epilogue.zh: 在某處，一個男孩健康地長大，卻從來不知道。

epilogue.en: The kiln fire went out the night he crossed.
epilogue.zh: 他渡河的那一夜，窯火熄了。

epilogue.en: On the far shore, a lantern lit itself.
epilogue.zh: 在彼岸，一盞燈籠自己亮了起來。

epilogue.en: The watchtower still stands. No one keeps it now.
epilogue.zh: 瞭望塔依然矗立。如今已無人看守。

epilogue.en: The audience stayed until the last note.
epilogue.zh: 觀眾一直留到最後一個音符。

epilogue.en: His coins went to the river, one by one.
epilogue.zh: 他的錢幣一枚接一枚，交給了河水。

epilogue.en: The abbot planted a plum tree by his grave.
epilogue.zh: 修道院長在他的墳旁種下一棵李樹。

text.en: The Echo can never be followed twice in a row. If the previous player Resonated, you cannot.
text.zh: 迴響永遠不能被連續跟隨兩次。若前一位玩家已共鳴，你便不能共鳴。

text.en: Whenever a Grievance rises, the soul steps back 1 space (if able). It does not Linger for this.
text.zh: 每當一個怨念升起，亡魂便後退1格（若可行）。亡魂不會因此徘徊。

text.en: The Light pool starts at −3. No Mantle can be summoned while Light is below 0.
text.zh: 光池從−3開始。光低於0時，無法召喚任何稱號。

text.en: You cannot Burn. Light as Ash triggers at 3 forgotten instead of 6.
text.zh: 你不能焚燒。輕如灰燼改為在遺忘3張時觸發，而非6張。

text.en: The first Fertile tile revealed in each Reach is treated as a Grave.
text.zh: 每個河段第一塊被掀開的沃土視為墳墓。

text.en: Black Water supply is 4. Roots drink a flood if either bank holds a Root or Bloom.
text.zh: 黑水供應為4。只要任一河岸有根或花，根便會吸乾洪水。

text.en: The first player plays with their hand face up. At each Reach transition, pass the "outsider" role to the left.
text.zh: 起始玩家將手牌正面朝上進行遊戲。每次切換河段時，將「局外人」角色傳給左手邊的玩家。

text.en: When you summon a Mantle from a teammate, pay no Light (you still discard a card).
text.zh: 當你從隊友處召喚稱號時，不需支付光（仍須棄置1張牌）。

text.en: Seed the Sea tile in Reach III. Fulfilled if it holds a Bloom when the soul passes.
text.zh: 在第三河段預置大海板塊。若亡魂經過時該板塊上有花，即達成。

endings.en: Salt wind. A wide grey sea. Enough.
endings.zh: 鹹鹹的風。一片寬闊的灰色大海。這樣就夠了。

endings.en: They saw the sea and did not know why they wept.
endings.zh: 他們看見了海，卻不知道自己為何落淚。

endings.en: They crossed inland, always facing away from the water.
endings.zh: 他們從內陸渡河，始終背對著水。

text.en: Fulfilled if, once, a Grievance fed the soul and was not removed during that turn.
text.zh: 若曾有一次，怨念啃噬了亡魂，且在該回合中沒有被移除，即達成。

endings.en: The one they wronged walked beside them to the Far Shore.
endings.zh: 他們曾虧欠的那個人，陪著他們走到了彼岸。

endings.en: Someone forgave them. They could not remember for what.
endings.zh: 有人原諒了他們。他們卻想不起是為了什麼。

endings.en: They drank from the cup still apologising.
endings.zh: 他們喝下那一杯時，仍在道歉。

text.en: Fulfilled if the soul reaches the Far Shore with 8 or more forgotten.
text.zh: 若亡魂抵達彼岸時已遺忘8張或更多，即達成。

endings.en: No name, no debt, no regret. Exactly as they wished.
endings.zh: 無名、無債、無悔。正如他們所願。

endings.en: They were remembered, and it hurt.
endings.zh: 他們被記住了，而那很痛。

text.en: Fulfilled if the Key Memory was Burned.
text.zh: 若關鍵記憶被焚燒，即達成。

endings.en: They gave away the dearest thing and felt it go.
endings.zh: 他們送出了最珍貴的東西，並感覺到它離去。

endings.en: They gave away something. It must have mattered.
endings.zh: 他們送出了某樣東西。那一定很重要。

endings.en: They held on. Their hands would not open.
endings.zh: 他們緊抓不放。他們的手怎麼也張不開。

text.en: At setup, mark one Book page. Fulfilled if that page is full.
text.zh: 設置時，標記憶念之書的一頁。若該頁填滿，即達成。

endings.en: The promise was kept, every word of it.
endings.zh: 承諾信守了，一字不差。

endings.en: The promise was kept. Its words were gone.
endings.zh: 承諾信守了。只是那些話語已不在。

endings.en: A blank page, where a promise should be.
endings.zh: 一頁空白，本該寫著一個承諾。

text.en: Fulfilled if the soul Lingered by choice once in each Reach (not due to a Hold).
text.zh: 若亡魂在每個河段都曾主動徘徊一次（並非因為堅守），即達成。

endings.en: They looked back three times, and then not again.
endings.zh: 他們回頭望了三次，之後便不再回頭。

endings.en: They waved at something in the fog.
endings.zh: 他們朝霧中的某樣東西揮了揮手。

endings.en: They left without a word.
endings.zh: 他們一語不發地離開了。

text.en: Fulfilled if no Mantle was held at any time in Reach III.
text.zh: 若在第三河段中任何時候都無人持有稱號，即達成。

endings.en: The last mile was theirs alone, and they were proud.
endings.zh: 最後一哩路只屬於他們自己，他們為此自豪。

endings.en: Alone, and not sure it was a choice.
endings.zh: 孤身一人，卻不確定那是否出於選擇。

endings.en: They were carried. They had wanted to walk.
endings.zh: 他們是被人抬著走的。他們本想自己走。

text.en: Seed the Waiting Soul tile in Reach II. Fulfilled if it was Rooted and Lit before the soul passed.
text.zh: 在第二河段預置等待的亡魂板塊。若亡魂經過之前，該板塊已扎根並被照亮，即達成。

endings.en: Two souls reached the Far Shore together.
endings.zh: 兩個亡魂一同抵達了彼岸。

endings.en: Someone held their hand. A stranger, they thought.
endings.zh: 有人握住了他們的手。他們以為是個陌生人。

endings.en: Someone waited at the ferry, and is waiting still.
endings.zh: 有人在渡口等待，至今仍在等待。
